name: a chatty session runs out of budget before its sibling goes unheard
why: Even within its allowed severities, one session must not monopolise the speaker. Eight lawful milestones from one session against a single line from another: the bucket lets the burst through, drops the excess, and the quiet session's one line still lands. Without the bucket the count is nine and the sibling waits behind all of them.
